title: Push browser coordinates
description: The client pushes coordinates from the browser Geolocation API. The plugin stores them as the lowest-priority GPS source and drops them after 10 seconds of staleness. The client must NOT send this while stats.gps.piFix is true.

message_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. When present the plugin echoes it in the reply and in the acknowledgment.

accuracy.description: Metres, as reported by the browser.
